# Harbour and Northline sign fare interoperability deal

By R. Okonkwo, 6 January 2026.

Harbour Transit Authority and Northline Ferries have signed an agreement that enables
Harbour cards to be used for fare payment on Northline coastal services.

The two operators said the arrangement covers more than forty terminals. Neither operator
gave a date for passenger availability.

An earlier industry estimate put the number of active Meridian Cards at 1.9 million.
